preserved_assertions: Relocated fixtures retain their prior assertions; no snapshot auto-accept or unique assertion removal.

execution.quick: All host behavioral scenarios once; sanitizer variants where supported; offline-admission and coverage-validator units once.
execution.full: Same host scenarios plus optimization/coverage; actual kernel boundary and supported stock/DYA core compilation use separate documented entries.
execution.outputs: Use a fresh evidence directory; existing evidence is never overwritten.
execution.coverage: Every gated range requires measured executable lines; empty, metadata-only and partial reports fail. Recording-tool controls validate admission; normal full runs measure actual compiled fixture coverage.

gaps: Physical USB/BLE/split delivery, timing, power and retention require matching production-board evidence.

Native settings fixture uses actual kernel threads/mutexes with controlled registry/device/setter and one selected stale-read interleaving; persistent storage, Studio and arbitrary scheduling remain separate.
Overlapping input fixture observes processor/listener state only; arbitrary routes outside this processor and actual host HID delivery require consuming integration evidence.
